Prism 1.30.0 (MIT), copied unchanged from the npm prismjs@1.30.0 components/*.min.js distribution.
Only the core and explicit grammars used by diff-syntax-worker.js are bundled.
No plugins, autoloader, styles or CDN requests. To update, replace these same files
from a pinned npm release, retain LICENSE and run the diff-syntax tests.
